{{- /* layouts/_partials/scripts-body-end/search-data.html Unified search data injection (Base v2.2+). Shared data layer for: Search, Explorer, Graph capabilities. Slug normalization matches legacy Quartz scripts-body.html: strip scheme+host, BaseURL path, .html suffix, /index suffix; empty → "index". Titles use partial "page-title.html" (not raw .Title) so section indexes and untitled pages get humanized labels for Explorer/Graph.
